author: ljuckett
body: TkDQM talk about changes: [Indico](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1724619/#b-687664-tracker-dqm) Update of TEDD terms/numbering to match requests from TEDD people: 1. Wheel is not used in TEDDs, instead use double-disk/DDisk/DD. Also, in plot titles use Z+/Z- side instead of side plus/side minus. 3. Ring numbering: the outer 2S rings should have the same ring numbers across all double-disks. Instead of TEDD 2 having rings 1 12, have 3 15. Same ring number = same type of modules, and similar r. Before: After: 4. Folder split of TEDD_1 and TEDD_2 not considered necessary -> Issues will affect individual double-disks, not entire TEDD_1/2.
title: [DQM] Tracker: Update TEDD terms
